cases.reply:
Fixed the failing test in `test/parse.test.js`. The bug was in `src/parse.js`, not the test: `new Date('2026-03-09')` is parsed as UTC midnight, but `parseDate` read it back with local getters, so in Los Angeles it came out as March 8. I switched it to `getUTCFullYear`/`getUTCMonth`/`getUTCDate`.

All 3 `parseDate` tests pass now, including under `TZ=America/Los_Angeles`.
